findings.title: State receive accepted missing required fields and destructive required-field merge
findings.origin: Existing implementation accepted states invalid under the canonical contract
findings.trigger: Remove attention, members or reducedMotion from a hash-consistent snapshot, or delete required members with merge-patch null. Explicit state null is also invalid.
findings.before: Receiver returned apply and adopted an invalid state.
findings.after: Validate complete state before atomic adoption; merge-patch null retains deletion semantics and the merged result must satisfy the state contract.

findings.status: fixed; scoped contract, production receive and native Swift model tests pass

findings.title: Authoritative snapshot restore silently discarded explicit null before validation
findings.origin: Existing invalid-input acceptance; this round adds enforcement, not a claim that the old guard covered it
findings.trigger: Restore a raw state snapshot with explicit null and a matching canonical hash. Serde Option accepts null and subsequent serialization omits it.
findings.before: Restore accepted the snapshot while changing canonical data.
findings.after: Validate the raw state before deserializing, reject null atomically, retain authoritative deny-unknown policy.

roles.author: semantic_contract
roles.independent_verify: Parent integration gate; no separate original-null probe log is claimed.

findings.title: Swift flattened Attention DTO rejected a valid unknown-variant field
findings.origin: Introduced by this round generated DTO validation; found during independent review
findings.trigger: attention.kind=future-gaze or none with unknown optional id=42.
findings.before: Rust/TS accepted both; Swift rejected both through a flattened known id string member.
findings.after: Generated DTO reader validates only the selected known variant and preserves raw unknown fields for hashing.
findings.status: fixed; all three validators agree on the five independent attention/date probes

findings.title: Consumer date validation normalized invalid dates and rejected valid leap seconds
findings.origin: Introduced/left uncovered by this round consumer validation; found during independent review
findings.before: TS/Swift accepted the first two and rejected the third; authoritative chrono did the opposite.
findings.after: Explicit component validation follows existing chrono structural RFC3339 behavior, without Date.parse normalization or leap-table inference; raw/hash inputs unchanged.
findings.status: fixed; 18 additional shared state cases pin the reviewed edges

findings.title: Import reported settings unchanged after prefs had already committed
findings.trigger: prefsPatch resolves after saving companionName, then companionApplyPrefs rejects with a lost apply response.
findings.before: The saved preference changes, but onPatch=false causes the library to say no write succeeded and settings are unchanged.
findings.after: Parent separates persisted/apply outcome handling and uses conservative import failure wording.
findings.status: fixed; production page with modeled two-IPC boundary passes

findings.title: Atomic preference replacement widened an existing private file mode
findings.origin: Existing temp-and-rename implementation defect, not newly introduced this round
findings.trigger: Create desktop.json with mode0600, call production save_prefs_at under the observed022 umask.
findings.after: Parent preserves the existing permissions and creates private temporary files.
findings.status: fixed; production writer on isolated real filesystem passes

findings.title: Failed temporary create removed a pre-existing file the writer did not own
findings.origin: This round new unconditional error cleanup
findings.trigger: In a fresh test subprocess precreate the expected PID/sequence temporary path, then invoke save_prefs_at.
findings.before: create_new rejects the collision and leaves desktop.json intact, but unconditional cleanup deletes the colliding file.
findings.after: Cleanup runs only for the temporary file successfully created by this invocation.
findings.risk_bound: Low-frequency collision requires a pre-existing PID/sequence path; no claim of remotely exploitable behavior.
findings.status: fixed; failed production create preserves both original and foreign temporary data

findings.title: Nested malformed backup fields were coerced into persisted strings
findings.origin: Existing malformed-input acceptance missed by new top-level guards
findings.trigger: companionFamiliars id=42, name=42, name={}, or palette=[maid-classic].
findings.before: String(...) silently accepts all four and returns a valid settings patch, including the name [object Object].
findings.after: Parent requires string id/name/palette before returning a patch; valid schema1 backups retain their behavior.
findings.status: fixed; four nested cases plus existing page/top-level cases pass

findings.title: Initial Shift+Tab escaped a newly opened modal and lost its Escape handler
findings.origin: Existing focus trap only guarded first/last children, not initial container focus
findings.trigger: Open the emergency-stop recovery dialog via Enter; container initially has focus; press Shift+Tab before entering any child.
findings.before: Browser focus leaves the dialog. An independently added unit case identifies the focused node as the background opener.
findings.after: Initial Tab/Shift+Tab target first/last child; an empty loading overlay prevents Tab escape. Existing close and focus restoration remain.
